name: 109 - Core - Verify Channel Authentication and Signature - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS client_name,
        $3::TEXT AS channel,
        NULLIF($4::TEXT, '') AS api_key,
        NULLIF($5::TEXT, '') AS source_ip,
        $6::BOOLEAN AS signature_verified,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '') AS verification_reference
),

client_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        client.id AS client_id,
        client.client_name,
        client.channel,
        client.provider_name,
        client.auth_mode,
        client.api_key_hash,
        client.signature_verifier_url,
        client.signature_credential_reference,
        client.allowed_ip_addresses,
        client.rate_limit_requests,
        client.rate_limit_window_seconds,
        client.replay_window_seconds,
        client.enabled,
        request.api_key,
        request.source_ip,
        request.signature_verified,
        request.verification_reference
    FROM request_data request
    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE
    INNER JOIN channel_gateway_clients client
        ON client.clinic_id = clinic.id
       AND client.client_name = request.client_name
       AND client.channel = request.channel
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM client_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN context.enabled = FALSE
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN CARDINALITY(
            context.allowed_ip_addresses
        ) > 0
         AND (
            context.source_ip IS NULL
            OR NOT (
                context.source_ip =
                ANY(context.allowed_ip_addresses)
            )
         )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN context.auth_mode = 'api_key'
         AND (
            context.api_key IS NULL
            OR context.api_key_hash IS NULL
            OR ENCODE(
                DIGEST(
                    context.api_key,
                    'sha256'
                ),
                'hex'
            ) <> context.api_key_hash
         )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN context.auth_mode = 'provider_signature'
         AND (
            context.signature_verified = FALSE
            OR context.verification_reference IS NULL
         )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN context.auth_mode = 'development_none'
            THEN TRUE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS allowed,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM client_context
        )
            THEN 'gateway_client_not_found'

        WHEN context.enabled = FALSE
            THEN 'gateway_client_disabled'

        WHEN CARDINALITY(
            context.allowed_ip_addresses
        ) > 0
         AND (
            context.source_ip IS NULL
            OR NOT (
                context.source_ip =
                ANY(context.allowed_ip_addresses)
            )
         )
            THEN 'source_ip_not_allowed'

        WHEN context.auth_mode = 'api_key'
         AND context.api_key IS NULL
            THEN 'api_key_missing'

        WHEN context.auth_mode = 'api_key'
         AND (
            context.api_key_hash IS NULL
            OR ENCODE(
                DIGEST(
                    context.api_key,
                    'sha256'
                ),
                'hex'
            ) <> context.api_key_hash
         )
            THEN 'api_key_invalid'

        WHEN context.auth_mode = 'provider_signature'
         AND context.signature_verified = FALSE
            THEN 'provider_signature_not_verified'

        WHEN context.auth_mode = 'provider_signature'
         AND context.verification_reference IS NULL
            THEN 'signature_verification_reference_missing'

        ELSE 'authentication_allowed'
    END AS result,

    context.clinic_id,
    context.client_id,
    context.client_name,
    context.channel,
    context.provider_name,
    context.auth_mode,

    context.rate_limit_requests,
    context.rate_limit_window_seconds,
    context.replay_window_seconds,

    context.signature_verifier_url,
    context.signature_credential_reference

FROM client_context context

UNION ALL

SELECT
    FALSE AS allowed,
    'gateway_client_not_found' AS result,
    NULL::BIGINT AS clinic_id,
    NULL::BIGINT AS client_id,
    NULL::TEXT AS client_name,
    NULL::TEXT AS channel,
    NULL::TEXT AS provider_name,
    NULL::TEXT AS auth_mode,
    NULL::INTEGER AS rate_limit_requests,
    NULL::INTEGER AS rate_limit_window_seconds,
    NULL::INTEGER AS replay_window_seconds,
    NULL::TEXT AS signature_verifier_url,
    NULL::TEXT AS signature_credential_reference

FROM request_data request
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM client_context
);

parameters.content:
## Authentication مرکزی Gateway

حالت‌های پشتیبانی‌شده:
- api_key
- provider_signature
- development_none

API Key خام ذخیره نمی‌شود.

provider_signature فقط زمانی پذیرفته می‌شود که Adapter داخلی نتیجه Verify را همراه verification_reference ارسال کند.
